name: Construction Photolog Acceptance Testing: A Public Specification Benchmark
description: Reproducibility package for Construction Photolog Acceptance Testing: A Public Specification Benchmark, by Byungyun Bae. It contains executable Python code, a 16-condition requirement ledger, frozen official May 2025 UFGS and FAR source snapshots, baseline manifests and results, the extended mutation audit, and the malformed-input mapping. The evidence covers 548 baseline cases, 262,144 profile-specific mutation cases, and 35 malformed-input challenges with nine permissible-change controls. Inputs are synthetic manifests, not observed construction-site photographs. The findings establish computational conformance within the declared test domains, not field performance, image authenticity or contractual acceptance. README_JCCE.md gives execution commands and version lineage; FILE_MANIFEST.json records the hashes of the original 25 entries. Author-created code and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0; third-party official source materials retain their applicable notices and rights. No manuscript file, personal contact details or internal work logs are included.
